data.narrative:
Astro Mechanica is a Series A-stage company in the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector, having raised $27M+ to date. The addressable comp universe comprises two public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and two private peers (Boom Supersonic, Hermeus), though the narrow stage-and-sector filtering yields insufficient overlap for robust median peer analysis.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable technique. Using total capital raised ($27M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, this method implies a valuation of $54M. This reflects normalized progression from seed/early-stage capitalization to Series A exit or extension rounds. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector (0 datapoints meeting filter thresholds); broader sector medians risked material distortion.

The triangulated valuation range is $46M–$62M, with a median of $54M, anchored primarily to stage-progression analysis. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-peer revenue or profitability benchmarks, typical given pre-commercialization status in frontier aerospace, and limited public market comp liquidity in this vertical. Any refinement would require either documented revenue traction, customer contracts, or expanded private peer data.
